{{Quote|Now those Mandalorians know what it's like to be hunted!|[[Jon (farmer)|Jon]]|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''confrontation on Dantooine''' was an encounter between the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and his allies and the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian]] leader [[Sherruk]]. The Mandalorians established themselves on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in the [[Jedi Civil War]] as mercenaries after [[Battle of Malachor V|their defeat]] in [[Mandalorian Wars|the previous war]]; the Mandalorians and their [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] allies were too numerous to be fended off. This resulted in properties plundered and settlers killed. The [[Jedi Enclave]] on the planet deemed the situation problematic and unfortunate but did not make a concrete intervention; this forced the settler Jon to make continual pleas to their [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|Council]] to intervene.<ref name="KOTOR" />

The Padawan Revan (who just completed his [[Jedi training/Legends|re-training]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zhar Lestin]]) decided to help [[Jon (farmer)|Jon]]. He confronted and defeated three separate Mandalorian units before he confronted and killed Sherruk and his forces in combat.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Mandalorian raiders, yes. They have been preying on the settlers in the surrounding farms. Stealing food, money, weapons...|[[Nemo]], to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] who survived [[Battle of Malachor V|their defeat]] in [[Mandalorian Wars|the previous war]] settled on various planets as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] or [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] for hire. Mandalorians like [[Canderous Ordo]] would take up such work in order to survive. Mandalorians under [[Sherruk]]'s command settled on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] sometime after the war and would plunder properties and kill settlers with their [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] allies. Two Mandalorians - [[Reeza]] and [[Jarg (Mandalorian)|Jarg]] - were slain in the [[Ancient Grove (Dantooine)|Ancient Grove]] when the pair stumbled upon the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Juhani]] who settled in the area.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Sherruk's mercenaries also killed the settler [[Jon (farmer)|Jon's]] daughter [[Ilsa]] when the mercenaries approached their residence. Jon decided to petition the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for help at their [[Jedi Enclave|enclave]] but found little to no assistance. The [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|Council]] deemed the raids a problematic and unfortunate issue but did not do much to repel the Mandalorian presence. But Sherruk did face some Jedi in combat and took their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] as trophies after he killed them. Their continual presence on Dantooine caused the settlers to grow further frustrated with Jedi inaction.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Mandalorian hunt==
{{Quote|I will add your head to those of the other Jedi I have killed, and take yet another lightsaber for my own.|[[Sherruk]] threatens Revan just before their confrontation|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
Jon was present outside the Jedi Enclave when he happened to meet the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] (and former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]) [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] (who had just completed his [[Jedi training/Legends|re-training]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zhar Lestin]]). Jon vented his frustrations at Revan about Jedi inaction before pleading with Revan to help him and his fellow settlers in removing the Mandalorian presence from the planet. Revan decided to help Jon and was told to eliminate their leader to remove the Mandalorian threat once and for all.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Revan encountered three Mandalorian units in various locations and defeated the mercenaries and their Duros allies. In one such location a man attempted to bargain for his life with the Mandalorians but was killed instead. Mandalorians were also spotted in a different location close to the [[Sandral estate|Sandral Estate]] with the third located close to the Ancient Grove.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Revan later encountered the mercenaries' leader Sherruk who decided to seize the chance to claim another lightsaber for his collection. But Revan and his two allies were able to defeat Sherruk and his allies in an encounter that removed the Mandalorian presence from Dantooine for a time.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Jon was grateful for Revan's assistance and - despite Revan's protests - provided him with a small reward for his efforts.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We had problems with Mandalorian mercenaries even before the Jedi Civil War. The Jedi helped clear most of the problem up.|[[Dillan]] references the Jedi's role in removing the Mandalorians to [[Meetra Surik]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
The Mandalorians disappeared from Dantooine for a time but a small set returned to the planet in the [[Dark Wars]] around [[3951 BBY]] to aid [[Azkul]] and [[Azkul's mercenaries|his mercenaries]] in [[Battle of Khoonda|the battle]] to take [[Khoonda]]. [[Dillan]] recalled the Mandalorian presence to [[Meetra Surik]] when she arrived on the planet and mentioned that a Jedi was responsible for ending their destructive spree before the planet was [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|attacked]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
